patterns.note: Full-bleed hero video section at the top, followed by product grids and a distinctive oversized brand logo section.
The brand name 'Bink' is used as a monumental, full-width graphic element, contrasting with smaller, clean sans-serif text for product details and navigation.
A minimalist palette of off-white and black is dominant, with product photography introducing a range of soft pastels and earthy tones as accents.

A sticky navigation bar transforms from transparent with white text over the hero video to a solid light background with black text after scrolling past the hero. A large, full-width 'Bink' logo section is revealed as the user scrolls down, acting as a bold visual break.
Product display sections are organized into horizontal carousels or multi-column grids, often with 'Shop The Look' or 'Shop Bestsellers' labels.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video playing in the background, with transparent call-to-action buttons overlaid. The navigation bar is initially transparent and fixed, then transitions to a solid background with contrasting text color as the user scrolls past the hero section, remaining sticky at the top. A large, full-width brand logo is revealed as a distinct, scroll-triggered section, acting as a strong visual anchor and brand statement. Product listings use a simple grid layout with minimal styling, allowing the product photography to dominate.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy sans-serif for the brand logo (~10x body), with clean, smaller sans-serif for product names and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on product cards and images, with pill-shaped buttons for primary calls to action.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open for hero and brand logo sections, transitioning to a balanced density for product grids and content sections.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the monumental, full-width 'Bink' logo that appears as a scroll-triggered section, transforming the page from a product showcase to a bold, graphic brand statement. This unexpected visual break creates a strong brand identity and memorable user experience.
